description:
Da Rocinha is an experimental musical study of Brazil's baile funk. 

During the process of the initial release of Da Rocinha, [Soulection - S014]
some tracks meant for the EP didn't make it. I recently went back into the files and reconstructed the outtakes to give it a better sound. Accompanied with remixes, I planned to give you more of Rocinha.

Da Rocinha (Original Release)

http://soulection.bandcamp.com/album/da-rocinha
